description: The pie chart titled “Token Routing Distribution” depicts how tokens are distributed across routing destinations, and it contains three slices. The largest slice is labeled “LOCAL,” shown in green, and is annotated as approximately 94.5% of the total. A smaller slice labeled “LLM,” shown in red, is annotated as about 3.9%. The smallest slice labeled “EDGE_P2P,” shown in blue, is annotated as about 1.6%. Percentage labels are printed inside the slices, there is no separate legend visible, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slices are visually ordered by size with LOCAL dominating most of the circle.
